config.label: Vulnify API key (vln_live_
config.description: Vulnify API key (vln_live_... or vln_test_...) for the local stdio process. The hosted server signs in with Vulnify and does not need this variable.

config.label: API base URL
config.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://api.vulnify.io.

config.label: Sign in with Vulnify (OAuth 2
config.description: Sign in with Vulnify (OAuth 2.1). Leave this header empty. Set it only to send an API key (vln_live_... or vln_test_...) as a Bearer token. X-Vulnify-Key also works.
